entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A powerful vampire and one of the oldest surviving planeswalkers, born over 7,000 years ago, who lorded over Innistrad.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Sorin's home plane, where he preserved the balance between humanity and the monsters who prey on them.

events.summary: Sorin lords over Innistrad for millennia, preserving the balance between humanity and the monsters that prey on them.
